### OgeDateBox — `<oge-date-box>`

#### Properties

_OgeDateBox_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dropdownPlacement` | `OgePopupPlacement` | `'bottom-start'` | Preferred popup side/alignment; flips when it would clip. |
| `adaptiveMode / adaptiveBreakpoint` | `'auto' \| 'none' / number` | `config: 'none' / 600` | `'auto'` presents the popup as a full-screen dialog with 44px day cells on viewports narrower than `adaptiveBreakpoint` px — a titled `role="dialog"` surface with a close button, scroll lock, inert background, a Tab trap, focus restore, safe-area insets and 16px / 44px touch sizing; Escape, a backdrop tap or a swipe down the handle dismiss it. `'none'` keeps the anchored drop-down. App-wide defaults come from `provideOgeInputsConfig()`. |
| `showDropDownButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Renders the rail button that toggles the picker; the field click and the keyboard still open it when hidden. |
| `value` | `model<Date \| null>` | `null` | Always a local `Date` — serialization is the app's concern (no `dateSerializationFormat`). CVA writes accept ISO-like strings and epoch numbers leniently. |
| `type` | `'date' \| 'time' \| 'datetime'` | `'date'` | Picker: calendar, interval time list, or both (no dx `pickerType`). The rail icon follows the type. |
| `displayFormat` | `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions \| ((d: Date) => string)` | `—` | Display text; `undefined` = per-type Intl defaults. No format strings, no date library. |
| `min / max / disabledDates` | `as OgeCalendar` | `—` | Out-of-range typed text marks the field invalid — it is never clamped (unlike the number box). |
| `interval` | `number` | `30` | Time list step in minutes. |
| `timeView` | `'list' \| 'columns'` | `'list'` | Time picker layout: one interval list, or hour + minute columns (plus seconds / AM-PM columns when enabled). Each column is a labelled listbox. |
| `hour12` | `boolean \| undefined` | `—` | Clock of the display text and the picker. `true` adds an AM/PM column to `timeView: 'columns'` (hours 12, 1 … 11); `false` forces 24-hour; `undefined` follows the locale with the single 24-entry hour column. |
| `showSeconds` | `boolean` | `false` | Seconds in the display text (`timeStyle: 'medium'`), a seconds column and a seconds segment of the masked entry; typed `HH:MM:SS` parses. Off, picks zero the seconds. |
| `showTodayButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Footer "Today" button (`date` / `datetime`): picks today through the calendar path — `datetime` keeps the time of day. Disabled when `min`/`max`/`disabledDates` exclude today. |
| `showNowButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Footer "Now" button (`time` / `datetime`): commits the current time (seconds kept only with `showSeconds`) and closes; with `useButtons` it drafts instead. |
| `useMaskBehavior` | `boolean` | `false` | Segment entry (DevExtreme `useMaskBehavior`): the field shows the locale’s numeric pattern (`dd.mm.yyyy`, `mm/dd/yyyy`… from `Intl`), digits fill the selected segment and auto-advance, ArrowUp/Down step it with wrap-around, ArrowLeft/Right (mirrored in RTL) and Home/End move between segments, Backspace/Delete clear, a typed separator moves on, `a`/`p` set AM/PM, paste reads a whole date and Alt+ArrowDown opens the picker. Commits on blur/Enter like typed text; impossible dates show the invalid state and revert. `displayFormat` is not used while it is on. |
| `applyValueMode` | `'instantly' \| 'useButtons'` | `'instantly'` | OK/Cancel footer collects picker changes in a draft when `useButtons`. |
| `acceptCustomValue` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` makes the text read-only (picker input only). |
| `openOnFieldClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Clicking the field opens the picker. |
| `firstDayOfWeek / showWeekNumbers / zoomLevel / calendarCellTemplate / locale` | `calendar passthroughs` | `—` | Exposed individually — no `calendarOptions` kitchen-sink object. |
| `opened` | `model<boolean>` | `false` | Picker visibility — two-way. |

_OgeDateRangeBox_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `model<[Date \| null, Date \| null]>` | `[null, null]` | Start–end tuple on one field: two parsed inputs + a two-view range calendar popup. A reversed pair reorders on commit; either end may stay open. |
| `type` | `OgeDateRangeBoxType` | `'date'` | `'datetime'` adds start/end time lists to the picker: day and time picks collect in a draft and commit together on OK; both sides parse and render times. `'time'` is a time-range picker — no calendar, two time lists and OK. |
| `presets` | `readonly OgeDateRangePreset[]` | `[]` | Quick ranges listed beside the calendar (a horizontal chip row in the adaptive dialog), each an `aria-pressed` button that reads pressed while the draft matches it. `{ label, range: () => [start, end] }` — `range` is evaluated on render and on pick, never at construction — or the built-in `ogeDateRangePresets.today() / yesterday() / last7Days() / last30Days() / thisWeek() / lastWeek() / thisMonth() / lastMonth() / thisYear() / lastYear()`, labelled from the messages. A `date` box commits and closes on a pick; `time`/`datetime` and the adaptive dialog draft it for OK/Done. |
| `hour12 / showSeconds` | `boolean \| undefined / boolean` | `—` | Clock and seconds of the display text and the time lists, as on `OgeDateBox`. |
| `interval` | `number` | `30` | Time list step in minutes (`type: 'time' \| 'datetime'`). |
| `min / max / disabledDates / firstDayOfWeek / showWeekNumbers / locale / displayFormat / openOnFieldClick / acceptCustomValue` | `as OgeDateBox` | `—` | Shared configuration surface. |
| `adaptiveMode / adaptiveBreakpoint` | `'auto' \| 'none' / number` | `config: 'none' / 600` | `'auto'` presents the popup as a full-screen dialog showing one month, where picking both ends waits for an explicit Done that applies the range on viewports narrower than `adaptiveBreakpoint` px — a titled `role="dialog"` surface with a close button, scroll lock, inert background, a Tab trap, focus restore, safe-area insets and 16px / 44px touch sizing; Escape, a backdrop tap or a swipe down the handle dismiss it. `'none'` keeps the anchored drop-down. App-wide defaults come from `provideOgeInputsConfig()`. |

### OgeColorBox — `<oge-color-box>`

#### Properties

_OgeColorBox_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dropdownPlacement` | `OgePopupPlacement` | `'bottom-start'` | Preferred popup side/alignment; flips when it would clip. |
| `adaptiveMode / adaptiveBreakpoint` | `'auto' \| 'none' / number` | `config: 'none' / 600` | `'auto'` presents the popup as a full-width bottom sheet on viewports narrower than `adaptiveBreakpoint` px — a titled `role="dialog"` surface with a close button, scroll lock, inert background, a Tab trap, focus restore, safe-area insets and 16px / 44px touch sizing; Escape, a backdrop tap or a swipe down the handle dismiss it. `'none'` keeps the anchored drop-down. App-wide defaults come from `provideOgeInputsConfig()`. |
| `showDropDownButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Renders the rail button that toggles the picker; the field click and the keyboard still open it when hidden. |
| `value` | `model<string \| null>` | `null` | The committed color as a CSS string, normalized to `format` on user commits. Programmatic writes keep any parseable CSS color verbatim (never reformatted); unparseable writes land as `null`. |
| `format` | `'hex' \| 'rgb' \| 'rgba' \| 'hsl'` | `'hex'` | Committed string shape (hex — the DevExtreme default; Kendo defaults to rgba). Translucent colors widen to carry alpha: `#rrggbbaa` / `rgba()` / `hsla()`. |
| `view` | `'gradient' \| 'palette' \| 'both'` | `'gradient'` | Popup surfaces: the saturation/brightness gradient with sliders and inputs, the swatch palette, or both stacked — no view switcher (Kendo's `activeView` is deliberately skipped). |
| `editAlphaChannel` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds the alpha slider + percent input and lets the output carry alpha. Without it, alpha is coerced to 1 on commit — `rgba()` text still parses. |
| `applyValueMode` | `'instantly' \| 'useButtons'` | `'instantly'` | OK/Cancel footer collects panel interactions in a draft when `useButtons`; the default commits live (dragging streams through `valueCommitted`, throttled by `debounce`). |
| `acceptCustomValue` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` makes the text read-only (picker input only). Typed text parses any CSS color incl. the 148 named colors; unparseable text reverts on blur. |
| `keyStep` | `number` | `5` | Arrow-key increment of the panel parts in value units — hue degrees, alpha percent, surface saturation/brightness percent. PageUp/PageDown move by 5× (value-space, not Kendo’s pixel steps — zoom-independent). |
| `palette` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `—` | Palette swatches as CSS color strings; `undefined` renders the exported `OGE_DEFAULT_COLOR_PALETTE`. Unparseable entries are dropped. |
| `paletteColumns` | `number` | `10` | Swatch columns of the palette grid. |
| `openOnFieldClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Clicking the field opens the picker. |
| `showDropDownButton` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` hides the rail chevron — field click and ArrowDown still open. |
| `showEyedropper` | `boolean` | `true` | The eyedropper button (pick a color from anywhere on screen) — rendered only in browsers shipping the `EyeDropper` API; progressive enhancement, no polyfill. The picked color keeps the working alpha. |
| `opened` | `model<boolean>` | `false` | Picker visibility — two-way. |

| `reset(value?: T): void` | `void` | Returns the field to pristine: sets `value` (default: empty), clears touched/dirty/parse errors, cancels pending commits. On a reactive-forms-bound editor resets the control itself. |

#### Events

_OgeColorBox events_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dropDownOpened / dropDownClosed` | `void` | Picker visibility changes, from any trigger. |

_Common (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueCommitted` | `OgeInputValueCommittedEvent<T>` | Every committed change with `previousValue` + originating DOM event (`undefined` for programmatic writes) — the reference `onValueChanged` shape. |
| `inputChange` | `OgeInputRawEvent` | Raw text on every keystroke, regardless of commit policy. |
| `cleared` | `void` | Value cleared via the clear button / `clear()`. |
| `enterKey` | `OgeInputKeyEvent` | Enter pressed inside the editor (pending debounce is flushed first). |
| `focused` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor received focus. |
| `blurred` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor lost focus. |
| `touch` | `void` | Signal Forms `FormValueControl` contract — emitted once per blur. |
| `valueChange` | `T` | Implicit output of the `value` model. |

#### Types

_Color types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeColorBoxView / OgeColorBoxApplyValueMode` | `types` | The string unions of `view` and `applyValueMode`. |
| `OGE_DEFAULT_COLOR_PALETTE` | `readonly string[]` | The built-in 50-swatch palette used when `palette` is not set. |
| `Color messages` | `OgeInputsMessages keys` | All popup strings localize through the family config: `colorPickerLabel`, `hueSliderLabel`/`hueValueText`, `alphaSliderLabel`/`alphaValueText`, `colorSurfaceLabel`/`colorSurfaceRoleDescription`/`surfaceValueText`, `paletteLabel`, the hex/R/G/B/A input labels, `eyedropperButton` and `invalidColorError`. |
| `parseColor / formatColor / normalizeColor / rgbaToHsva / hsvaToRgba / relativeLuminance / contrastForeground / colorsEqual` | `@oge-ui/core` | The DOM-free color kernel (`OgeRgba` / `OgeHsva` / `OgeColorFormat`): CSS color-text parsing, HSV↔RGB conversion, canonical formatting and the WCAG swatch-contrast decision — unit-tested without a DOM, the slider-math precedent. |

### OgeColorGradient — `<oge-color-gradient>`

#### Properties

_OgeColorGradient_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `model<string \| null>` | `null` | The committed color as a CSS string, normalized to `format` on commit; parseable programmatic values are kept verbatim — two-way. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the `role="group"`; falls back to the `colorGradientLabel` message. |
| `format` | `OgeColorFormat` | `'hex'` | Committed string shape (`hex` / `rgb` / `rgba` / `hsl`); translucent colors widen to carry alpha. |
| `editAlphaChannel` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the alpha slider and the alpha-percent input, and commits alpha-carrying strings. |
| `keyStep` | `number` | `5` | Arrow-key increment of the surface and sliders (degrees / percent); PageUp/PageDown move 5×. |
| `showInputs` | `boolean` | `true` | Renders the hex + R/G/B(/A) inputs. They commit on `change` (blur / Enter); unusable text is reverted, never applied. |
| `showContrast` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the WCAG contrast readout — a sample, the ratio and AA / AAA pass-fail badges (Kendo’s `contrastTool`). |
| `contrastBackground` | `string` | `'#ffffff'` | The background (any CSS color) the contrast ratio is measured against — set it to the surface the color will sit on. |

#### Types

_Contrast & palette helpers_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `contrastRatio` | `(foreground: OgeRgba, background: OgeRgba) => number` | WCAG 2.x contrast ratio (1–21). A translucent foreground is composited over the background first, so the ratio describes the rendered pair. Re-exported from `@oge-ui/behavior`. |
| `contrastLevels` | `(ratio: number) => OgeContrastLevels` | Classifies a ratio against AA (4.5), AA large (3), AAA (7) and AAA large (4.5). The comparison runs on the unrounded ratio; the displayed `ratio` is truncated, never rounded up into a pass. |
| `OgeContrastLevels` | `{ ratio; aa; aaLarge; aaa; aaaLarge }` | Result of `contrastLevels`. |

### OgeRating — `<oge-rating>`

#### Properties

_OgeRating_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `model<number \| null>` | `null` | The rating — two-way; `null` means not rated. Snapped to `precision` inside `0…max`. |
| `max` | `number \| undefined` | `5` | Number of items (stars); `undefined` means 5. A Signal Forms schema `max()` writes it through `[formField]`. |
| `precision` | `number` | `1` | Value step: `1` whole items, `0.5` halves, `0.1` tenths (at least `0.01`). A pointer press rounds up to the next step inside the item. |
| `allowClear` | `boolean` | `true` | A press on the current value — or Delete / Backspace / `0` — clears it; also lowers `aria-valuemin` to 0. |
| `icon` | `OgeRatingIcon` | `'star'` | The built-in glyph: `'star' \| 'heart' \| 'circle'`. An item template replaces it. |
| `selection` | `OgeRatingSelection` | `'continuous'` | `'continuous'` paints every item up to the value; `'single'` only the item holding it (a pick-one scale). |
| `semantics` | `OgeRatingSemantics` | `'slider'` | `'slider'` — one APG slider, any precision; `'radiogroup'` — one radio per item with a roving tab stop (whole-item precision only, otherwise the slider). |
| `hoverPreview` | `boolean` | `true` | Paints the value under a mouse pointer before it is pressed. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name; empty falls back to the `ratingLabel` message. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Locale of the spoken value (`aria-valuetext`); falls back to the config `locale`, then `LOCALE_ID`. |
| `itemTemplate` | `TemplateRef<OgeRatingItemTemplateContext> \| undefined` | `—` | Custom glyph per item — the input form of the `[ogeRatingItemTemplate]` slot. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Item size preset — 18 / 24 / 32px. |

| `cleared` | `void` | Value cleared via the clear button / `clear()`. |
| `enterKey` | `OgeInputKeyEvent` | Enter pressed inside the editor (pending debounce is flushed first). |
| `focused` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor received focus. |
| `blurred` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor lost focus. |
| `touch` | `void` | Signal Forms `FormValueControl` contract — emitted once per blur. |
| `valueChange` | `T` | Implicit output of the `value` model. |

#### Types

_Rating types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeRatingItemTemplate` | `directive` | `<ng-template ogeRatingItemTemplate let-item let-filled="filled">` — rendered for the empty and the filled (clipped) layer of every item, so fractional fills work with any markup. |
| `OgeRatingItemTemplateContext` | `{ $implicit: OgeRatingItemState; filled: boolean; hovered: boolean }` | Context of the item template. |
| `OgeRatingItemState` | `{ index; itemValue; fill; full; partial }` | One item: zero-based `index`, the `itemValue` a full press commits, the filled share `fill` (0…1). |
| `OgeRatingIcon` | `'star' \| 'heart' \| 'circle'` | The built-in glyphs. |
| `OgeRatingSelection` | `'continuous' \| 'single'` | How the value is painted. |
| `OgeRatingSemantics` | `'slider' \| 'radiogroup'` | The ARIA pattern rendered. |
| `OgeRatingHoverEvent` | `{ value: number \| null; event: Event }` | Payload of `hoverChanged`. |
| `Keyboard` | `APG slider / radio group` | Slider: ArrowRight/ArrowUp step up by `precision`, ArrowLeft/ArrowDown down (horizontal arrows mirror in RTL), PageUp/PageDown by one item, Home/End, digits `1`–`9` jump, Delete/Backspace/`0` clear. Radio group: arrows move and select with wrapping, Home/End, Space. |
| `Messages` | `OgeInputsMessages` | `ratingLabel`, `ratingValueText` (`{value}` / `{max}`, or an ICU plural) and `ratingNoValueText`. |

### OgeOtpInput — `<oge-otp-input>`

#### Properties

_OgeOtpInput_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `model<string>` | `''` | The characters entered — always a contiguous prefix, so `value.length === length` means complete. Two-way. |
| `length` | `number` | `6` | Number of cells (1–12). |
| `type` | `OgeOtpInputType` | `'numeric'` | Accepted characters: `'numeric'` (script and full-width digits fold to ASCII), `'alphanumeric'` or `'alphabetic'`. Rejected characters never land. |
| `letterCase` | `OgeOtpInputCase` | `'none'` | `'upper'` / `'lower'` applied to typed and pasted letters. |
| `masked` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the characters like a password field (PINs). |
| `groupSize` | `number` | `0` | Draws `separator` after every `groupSize` cells (`3` → 123–456); `0` = none. |
| `separator` | `string` | `'–'` | Separator glyph between groups — decorative, hidden from assistive technology. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder character shown in empty cells. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible group label and the group’s accessible name; empty falls back to the `otpLabel` message. |
| `hint` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Helper text under the cells (hidden while an error shows). |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Locale of the cell names’ digits; falls back to the config `locale`, then `LOCALE_ID`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Cell size preset. |

_Common — state & forms (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the editor. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Focusable but not editable. (Contract name — not `readOnly`.) |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required (label asterisk + validation). |
| `name` | `string` | `''` | Native `name` attribute. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | External invalid override — combined with forms state. |
| `pending` | `boolean` | `false` | Async-validation indicator; a spinner shows in the rail while `true`. |
| `touched` | `boolean` | `false` | External touched override (Signal Forms contract). |
| `dirty` | `boolean` | `false` | External dirty override (Signal Forms contract). |
| `errors` | `readonly OgeFieldError[]` | `[]` | Signal Forms validation errors (auto-bound by `[formField]`). |
| `errorText` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Explicit error message — always wins over resolved messages. |
| `errorDisplay` | `OgeInputErrorDisplay` | `'touched'` | When resolved errors become visible. |
| `debounce` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Commit delay in ms for `value`/forms updates; blur and Enter flush immediately. |

#### Methods

_Common (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus(): void` | `void` | Moves keyboard focus to the native input. |
| `blur(): void` | `void` | Blurs the native input. |
| `clear(): void` | `void` | Clears the value (commits immediately), keeps focus in the field; no-op when disabled/readonly. |
| `reset(value?: T): void` | `void` | Returns the field to pristine: sets `value` (default: empty), clears touched/dirty/parse errors, cancels pending commits. On a reactive-forms-bound editor resets the control itself. |

#### Events

_OgeOtpInput events_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `completed` | `OgeOtpCompletedEvent` | Every cell got filled — by typing, a paste or the SMS autofill: `{ value, event }`. |

_Common (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueCommitted` | `OgeInputValueCommittedEvent<T>` | Every committed change with `previousValue` + originating DOM event (`undefined` for programmatic writes) — the reference `onValueChanged` shape. |
| `inputChange` | `OgeInputRawEvent` | Raw text on every keystroke, regardless of commit policy. |
| `cleared` | `void` | Value cleared via the clear button / `clear()`. |
| `enterKey` | `OgeInputKeyEvent` | Enter pressed inside the editor (pending debounce is flushed first). |
| `focused` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor received focus. |
| `blurred` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor lost focus. |
| `touch` | `void` | Signal Forms `FormValueControl` contract — emitted once per blur. |
| `valueChange` | `T` | Implicit output of the `value` model. |

#### Types

_OTP input types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeOtpInputType` | `'numeric' \| 'alphanumeric' \| 'alphabetic'` | Which characters a cell accepts. |
| `OgeOtpInputCase` | `'none' \| 'upper' \| 'lower'` | Letter case applied to accepted letters. |
| `OgeOtpCompletedEvent` | `{ value: string; event: Event \| undefined }` | Payload of `completed`. |
| `Keyboard` | `one Tab stop` | Only the caret cell is tabbable. Typing fills and advances, Backspace clears and steps back, Delete closes the gap, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (RTL-mirrored) and Home/End move; a cell past the first empty one hands the focus back to it. |
| `Autofill` | `autocomplete="one-time-code"` | On the first cell, so iOS/Android SMS suggestions fill the whole code; a paste of a whole code always fills from the first cell. |
| `Messages` | `OgeInputsMessages` | `otpLabel` (group name without a `label`) and `otpCellLabel` (`{index}` / `{length}`). |

### OgeListBox — `<oge-list-box>`

#### Properties

_OgeListBox_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `model<unknown>` | `null` | The selection — one `valueExpr` result (or `null`) in single mode, an items-ordered array in multiple mode. Two-way. |
| `items` | `readonly TItem[]` | `[]` | The options. |
| `displayExpr / valueExpr / disabledExpr` | `shared with OgeSelectBox` | `—` | Field-name string or function expressions; disabled options are skipped by the keyboard and keep their state. |
| `groupBy` | `OgeSelectGroupExpr<TItem> \| undefined` | `—` | Groups the options under headers (first-seen group order); each group is a `role="group"` labelled by its header. |
| `selectionMode` | `OgeListBoxSelectionMode` | `'single'` | `'single'` (selection follows focus) or `'multiple'` (`aria-multiselectable`). |
| `showCheckBoxes` | `boolean` | `false` | A check glyph on every option (multiple mode only). |
| `searchEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | A search field above the list that filters the options. |
| `searchExpr / searchMode` | `OgeSelectSearchExpr<TItem> / 'contains' \| 'startswith'` | `— / 'contains'` | Which text the search matches (default: the display text) and how. |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Placeholder of the search field; `undefined` = the `listBoxSearchPlaceholder` message. |
| `height` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `—` | Maximum list height — a px number or any CSS length; the list scrolls past it (default 280px). |
| `noDataText` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Text while there are no (matching) options; `undefined` = the `noDataText` message. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible label above the list and its accessible name; without one the list is named by the `listBoxLabel` message. |
| `labelledBy` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Id of an external element naming the list (overrides `label`) — what the transfer list uses for its titles. |
| `hint` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Helper text under the list, hidden while an error shows. |
| `keyShortcuts` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Shortcuts a host handles on the list, advertised as `aria-keyshortcuts`. |
| `allowReordering` | `boolean` | `false` | Lets the user reorder the options: Alt+↑/↓ moves the active option, a pointer drag (touch: after a long press) drops it before / after another. The list shows the new order at once and announces it; persist the `reordered` payload's `items` — a new `items` array resets the order. Moves stay inside a group, pass rows a search hides, and never move a disabled option. |
| `itemTemplate` | `TemplateRef<OgeListBoxItemTemplateContext<TItem>> \| undefined` | `—` | Option content as a `TemplateRef`; wins over a projected `[ogeListBoxItemTemplate]`. The option keeps its role, state and check glyph. |
| `groupTemplate` | `TemplateRef<OgeListBoxGroupTemplateContext> \| undefined` | `—` | Group header content; wins over a projected `[ogeListBoxGroupTemplate]`. |

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Focusable but not editable. (Contract name — not `readOnly`.) |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required (label asterisk + validation). |
| `name` | `string` | `''` | Native `name` attribute. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | External invalid override — combined with forms state. |
| `pending` | `boolean` | `false` | Async-validation indicator; a spinner shows in the rail while `true`. |
| `touched` | `boolean` | `false` | External touched override (Signal Forms contract). |
| `dirty` | `boolean` | `false` | External dirty override (Signal Forms contract). |
| `errors` | `readonly OgeFieldError[]` | `[]` | Signal Forms validation errors (auto-bound by `[formField]`). |
| `errorText` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Explicit error message — always wins over resolved messages. |
| `errorDisplay` | `OgeInputErrorDisplay` | `'touched'` | When resolved errors become visible. |
| `debounce` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Commit delay in ms for `value`/forms updates; blur and Enter flush immediately. |

#### Methods

_OgeListBox methods_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectAll() / unselectAll()` | `void` | Selects / deselects every enabled option (disabled options keep their state). |
| `scrollToItem(item: TItem): void` | `void` | Makes the item the active option and scrolls it into view. |
| `search(text: string): void` | `void` | Sets the search text programmatically; `''` clears the filter. |
| `getVisibleItems() / getSelectedItems()` | `readonly TItem[] / TItem[]` | The options currently shown (after the search) in display order / the selected items in items order. |
| `reorderItem(item, target, position?, cause?): boolean` | `boolean` | Moves `item` before (default) / after `target` through the same cancelable path as the keys and the pointer; `false` when it cannot move or a `reordering` handler cancelled it. `cause` defaults to `'api'` (the transfer list passes `'drag'`). |

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus(): void` | `void` | Moves keyboard focus to the native input. |
| `blur(): void` | `void` | Blurs the native input. |

| `itemClick` | `OgeListBoxItemClickEvent<TItem>` | An enabled option was clicked — `{ item, index, event }` (fires in read-only mode too). |
| `reordering` | `OgeListBoxReorderingEvent<TItem>` | Cancelable pre-event of every reorder — `{ item, fromIndex, toIndex, cause, event, cancel }`; indices into the whole `items` array. |
| `reordered` | `OgeListBoxReorderedEvent<TItem>` | An option moved — `{ item, fromIndex, toIndex, cause, items, event }`, after the announcement (`listBoxReorderedAnnouncement`). |

#### Types

_List box types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeListBoxSelectionMode` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | The selection model. |
| `OgeListBoxItemTemplate` | `[ogeListBoxItemTemplate]` | Structural directive for the option content; context `OgeListBoxItemTemplateContext` = `{ $implicit: item, index, selected, active, disabled }`. |
| `OgeListBoxGroupTemplate` | `[ogeListBoxGroupTemplate]` | Structural directive for group headers; context `OgeListBoxGroupTemplateContext` = `{ $implicit: label, count }`. |
| `OgeListBoxSelectionChangedEvent / OgeListBoxItemClickEvent / OgeListBoxReorderingEvent / OgeListBoxReorderedEvent` | `event payloads` | See the events table. |
| `OgeListBoxReorderCause` | `'keyboard' \| 'drag' \| 'api'` | What started a reorder. |
| `Keyboard` | `APG listbox` | One Tab stop (`aria-activedescendant`). ↑/↓, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown move the active option — in `single` mode the selection follows. Typing jumps by prefix (accent-insensitive; repeat a letter to cycle). Multiple: Space/Enter toggle, Shift+↑/↓ and Shift+Space extend from the anchor, Ctrl+Shift+Home/End select to an edge, Ctrl+A (⌘A) selects all — or none when all are selected. In the search field ↓ moves into the list. |

### OgeTransferList — `<oge-transfer-list>`

#### Properties

_OgeTransferList_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `model<readonly unknown[]>` | `[]` | The target side — the moved items’ `valueExpr` results in arrival order. Two-way. |
| `items` | `readonly TItem[]` | `[]` | Every item; those not in `value` form the source list (items order). |
| `displayExpr / valueExpr / disabledExpr` | `shared with OgeSelectBox` | `—` | Field-name string or function expressions; disabled items cannot be selected or moved. |
| `groupBy` | `OgeSelectGroupExpr<TItem> \| undefined` | `—` | Groups both lists’ options under headers. |
| `sourceTitle / targetTitle` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | List titles (and accessible names); `undefined` = the `transferSourceTitle` / `transferTargetTitle` messages. |
| `searchEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | A search field above each list. The buttons act on what a list shows: “move all” is enabled only while the filtered view holds a movable item, “move selected” only while a selected item is visible. |
| `searchExpr / searchMode` | `OgeSelectSearchExpr<TItem> / 'contains' \| 'startswith'` | `— / 'contains'` | Which text the search matches and how. |
| `showCheckBoxes` | `boolean` | `false` | Check glyphs on the options of both lists. |
| `height` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `—` | Maximum height of each list — px number or CSS length. |
| `noDataText` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Text of an empty list. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible label above both lists; the `role="group"`’s accessible name. |
| `hint` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Helper text under the lists, hidden while an error shows. |
| `itemTemplate / groupTemplate` | `TemplateRef \| undefined` | `—` | Option / group header content for both lists; win over projected `[ogeListBoxItemTemplate]` / `[ogeListBoxGroupTemplate]`. |
| `allowReordering` | `OgeTransferListReorderSides` | `false` | Lets the user reorder a list — `true` both, `'source'` / `'target'` only that one. Alt+↑/↓ moves the active option; one drag reorders when dropped inside its own list and moves when dropped on the other. The target's order is the value's order (a reorder commits it); a reordered source keeps its order until `items` changes. |

_Common — state & forms (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the editor. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Focusable but not editable. (Contract name — not `readOnly`.) |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required (label asterisk + validation). |
| `name` | `string` | `''` | Native `name` attribute. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | External invalid override — combined with forms state. |
| `pending` | `boolean` | `false` | Async-validation indicator; a spinner shows in the rail while `true`. |

| `dirty` | `boolean` | `false` | External dirty override (Signal Forms contract). |

| `errorText` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Explicit error message — always wins over resolved messages. |
| `errorDisplay` | `OgeInputErrorDisplay` | `'touched'` | When resolved errors become visible. |

#### Events

_OgeTransferList events_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `moving` | `OgeTransferListMovingEvent<TItem>` | Cancelable pre-event of every move — `{ items, values, from, to, cause, cancel }`; `cause` is `'button' \| 'keyboard' \| 'drag'`. |
| `moved` | `OgeTransferListMovedEvent<TItem>` | Items changed sides — `{ items, values, from, to, cause, value }`, after the commit and the live announcement. |
| `reordering` | `OgeTransferListReorderingEvent<TItem>` | Cancelable pre-event of a reorder inside one list — `{ side, item, fromIndex, toIndex, cause, event, cancel }`. |
| `reordered` | `OgeTransferListReorderedEvent<TItem>` | An item moved inside one list — `{ side, item, fromIndex, toIndex, cause, items, value, event }`; a target reorder has already committed the new `value`. |

| Name | Type | Description |

#### Types

_Transfer list types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTransferListSide` | `'source' \| 'target'` | One side of the transfer list. |
| `OgeTransferListMoveCause` | `'button' \| 'keyboard' \| 'drag'` | What triggered a move — all three run the same move path. |
| `OgeTransferListReorderSides` | `boolean \| 'source' \| 'target'` | Which lists `allowReordering` opens. |
| `Keyboard` | `listbox + shortcuts` | Every list box key on each list, plus Ctrl/⌘+→ (from the source) / Ctrl/⌘+← (from the target) to move the selection toward the other list — with Shift, everything shown. Visual arrows, mirrored in RTL, advertised with `aria-keyshortcuts`. |
| `Drag and drop` | `beginPointerDragDrop` | Drag an option (or the selection it belongs to) onto the other list — mouse and pen at once, touch after a long press; Escape cancels. The drop runs the same move as the buttons. |
| `Announcements` | `OgeLiveAnnouncer` | Every move is announced politely through the shared live announcer (`transferMovedAnnouncement`, an ICU plural). |

### OgeSignaturePad — `<oge-signature-pad>`

#### Properties

_OgeSignaturePad_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `model<string \| null>` | `null` | The signature as a `data:` URL in `format` — two-way. Writing a stored value back restores the pad’s own SVG export as strokes; any other image URL is shown (sanitized) until the next stroke replaces it. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the pad; falls back to the `signatureLabel` message. |
| `placeholder` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Text on the empty pad; `undefined` = the `signaturePlaceholder` message (“Sign here”), an empty string hides it. |
| `format` | `OgeSignatureFormat` | `'png'` | Export format of `value` and of `toDataUrl()` without an argument. |
| `mode` | `model<OgeSignatureMode>` | `'draw'` | Draw with a pointer or type a name — two-way. |
| `allowTyping` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the Draw / Type switch — the keyboard-accessible alternative (WCAG 2.1.1). |
| `height` | `number` | `160` | Surface height in px; the width follows the host (`--oge-signature-pad-width`, 420px). |
| `strokeColor` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Ink colour; `undefined` = the `--oge-signature-ink` token (forced colors repaint it). |
| `backgroundColor` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Background baked into the export; `undefined` = transparent. |
| `minWidth` | `number` | `1` | Thinnest stroke width in px — reached at high pen speed. |
| `maxWidth` | `number` | `3` | Thickest stroke width in px — reached when the pen moves slowly. |
| `fontFamily` | `string` | `script stack + 'cursive'` | Font of a typed signature, on screen and in the export. |

_Common — state & forms (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the editor. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Focusable but not editable. (Contract name — not `readOnly`.) |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required (label asterisk + validation). |
| `name` | `string` | `''` | Native `name` attribute. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | External invalid override — combined with forms state. |
| `pending` | `boolean` | `false` | Async-validation indicator; a spinner shows in the rail while `true`. |
| `touched` | `boolean` | `false` | External touched override (Signal Forms contract). |
| `dirty` | `boolean` | `false` | External dirty override (Signal Forms contract). |
| `errors` | `readonly OgeFieldError[]` | `[]` | Signal Forms validation errors (auto-bound by `[formField]`). |
| `errorText` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Explicit error message — always wins over resolved messages. |
| `errorDisplay` | `OgeInputErrorDisplay` | `'touched'` | When resolved errors become visible. |
| `debounce` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Commit delay in ms for `value`/forms updates; blur and Enter flush immediately. |

#### Methods

_OgeSignaturePad methods_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `undo(): void` | `void` | Removes the last stroke and re-exports the value. |
| `toDataUrl(format?): string \| null` | `string \| null` | The signature as a `data:` URL (default: `format`); `null` when empty. |
| `toSvg(): string \| null` | `string \| null` | The signature as an SVG document string; `null` when empty. |
| `setMode(mode): void` | `void` | Switches between drawing and typing, re-exporting the value. |
| `isEmpty(): boolean` | `boolean` | No signature (`value === null`). |

_Common (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus(): void` | `void` | Moves keyboard focus to the native input. |
| `blur(): void` | `void` | Blurs the native input. |
| `clear(): void` | `void` | Clears the value (commits immediately), keeps focus in the field; no-op when disabled/readonly. |
| `reset(value?: T): void` | `void` | Returns the field to pristine: sets `value` (default: empty), clears touched/dirty/parse errors, cancels pending commits. On a reactive-forms-bound editor resets the control itself. |

#### Events

_OgeSignaturePad events_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `strokeEnded` | `OgeSignatureStrokeEvent` | A stroke was completed (pen up) and committed. |
| `modeChange` | `OgeSignatureMode` | Implicit output of the `mode` model. |

_Common (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueCommitted` | `OgeInputValueCommittedEvent<T>` | Every committed change with `previousValue` + originating DOM event (`undefined` for programmatic writes) — the reference `onValueChanged` shape. |
| `inputChange` | `OgeInputRawEvent` | Raw text on every keystroke, regardless of commit policy. |
| `cleared` | `void` | Value cleared via the clear button / `clear()`. |
| `enterKey` | `OgeInputKeyEvent` | Enter pressed inside the editor (pending debounce is flushed first). |
| `focused` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor received focus. |
| `blurred` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor lost focus. |
| `touch` | `void` | Signal Forms `FormValueControl` contract — emitted once per blur. |
| `valueChange` | `T` | Implicit output of the `value` model. |

#### Types

_Signature pad types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeSignatureFormat` | `'png' \| 'svg'` | Export format. PNG renders through a canvas (falling back to SVG where no 2D context exists, e.g. SSR or jsdom); SVG is built without the DOM and embeds the strokes in a `<metadata>` element, so the value restores an editable pad. |
| `OgeSignatureMode` | `'draw' \| 'type'` | Pointer drawing, or the keyboard-accessible typed signature (a labelled text field rendered in `fontFamily`). |
| `OgeSignatureStroke` | `{ points: readonly OgeSignaturePoint[] }` | One pen-down → pen-up trace. |
| `OgeSignaturePoint` | `{ x: number; y: number; t: number }` | A sample in surface-relative coordinates (`0..1` on both axes) with its time in ms — why a resized pad redraws exactly. |
| `OgeSignatureStrokeEvent` | `{ stroke: OgeSignatureStroke; strokeCount: number; event: Event \| undefined }` | Payload of the stroke-ended event. |
| `Keyboard` | `buttons + text field` | Draw / Type is a pressed-state button pair; Undo (also Ctrl+Z anywhere in the pad) and Clear are real buttons; Escape mid-stroke cancels the stroke. The surface is `role="img"` named “label, signed / not signed”. |

### OgeMention — `<oge-mention>`

#### Properties

_OgeMention_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `model<string>` | `''` | The text, mentions included as plain-text tokens — two-way. |
| `mentions` | `model<readonly OgeMentionToken<T>[]>` | `[]` | The inserted mentions in text order — two-way, kept in step with every edit (a token edited away drops out). |
| `triggers` | `readonly OgeMentionTrigger<T>[] \| undefined` | `—` | Several trigger characters with their own items and expressions; overrides the single-trigger shorthand below. |
| `items` | `OgeMentionItemsSource<T>` | `[]` | Shorthand single trigger: its suggestions — a list or a function of the query. |
| `trigger` | `string` | `'@'` | Shorthand single trigger: its character. |
| `displayExpr` | `OgeSelectBoxDisplayExpr<T> \| undefined` | `—` | Shorthand: item → display text, also the inserted token text. |
| `valueExpr` | `OgeSelectBoxValueExpr<T> \| undefined` | `—` | Shorthand: item → the `value` reported in `mentions` (default: the item). |
| `searchExpr` | `OgeSelectBoxSearchExpr<T> \| undefined` | `—` | Shorthand: which text the local filter matches (default: the display text). |
| `searchMode` | `OgeSelectBoxSearchMode` | `'contains'` | Substring or prefix matching of local items. |
| `minSearchLength` | `number` | `0` | Characters required after the trigger before suggestions show. |
| `maxSuggestions` | `number` | `8` | Caps the suggestion list. |
| `allowSpaces` | `boolean` | `false` | Lets a query run across spaces (`@Ada Lo`); line breaks always end it. |
| `insertSpace` | `boolean` | `true` | Adds a space after the inserted token (unless one follows already). |
| `searchTimeout` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Debounce (ms) before a query function is called; `undefined` = the config `searchTimeoutMs` (250). |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | `true` | A text area (`true`) or a single-line combobox field. |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Visible rows of the text area. |
| `maxLength` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Native `maxlength`. |
| `spellcheck` | `boolean` | `true` | Native `spellcheck`. |
| `dropdownMaxHeight` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Suggestion list height cap; `undefined` = the CSS default (320px). |
| `itemTemplate` | `TemplateRef<OgeMentionItemTemplateContext<T>> \| undefined` | `—` | Custom suggestion row; an `[ogeMentionItemTemplate]` child wins. |

_Common — field chrome (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Field label; placement follows `labelMode`. |
| `labelMode` | `OgeInputLabelMode` | `'static'` | Label placement: static / floating / hidden (aria-only) / outside. |
| `stylingMode` | `OgeInputStylingMode` | `'outlined'` | Container fill style. |
| `size` | `OgeInputSize` | `'md'` | Container height preset — 28/34/42px, the button scale. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Native placeholder text. |
| `hint` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Helper text in the subscript region (hidden while an error shows). |
| `tooltip` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Native `title` attribute of the input element. |
| `subscriptSizing` | `OgeInputSubscriptSizing` | `'fixed'` | Whether the hint/error line reserves height, collapses, or is removed. |
| `fluid` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches the field to 100% width (default 240px via `--oge-input-width`). |
| `width` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `—` | This field’s width — a number is px, a string any CSS length. Sets `--oge-input-width` on this host only; `fluid` still wins. |
| `showClearButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the clear (✕) button while the field has a value. |
| `showSuccessIcon` | `OgeInputShowSuccessIcon` | `false` | Success icon when valid: `false` / on touch / always. |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Base for the generated element ids (input/label/hint/error/counter). |
| `tabIndex` | `number` | `0` | Tab order of the native input. |
| `autofocus` | `boolean` | `false` | Focuses the editor after its first render. |
| `selectOnFocus` | `boolean` | `false` | Selects the whole text when the input receives focus. |
| `inputAttr` | `Record<string, string>` | `{}` | Escape hatch: extra attributes rendered onto the native input (template-owned attributes are ignored). |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeInputsMessages> \| undefined` | `—` | Per-instance overrides of user-facing strings. |

_Common — state & forms (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the editor. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Focusable but not editable. (Contract name — not `readOnly`.) |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required (label asterisk + validation). |
| `name` | `string` | `''` | Native `name` attribute. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | External invalid override — combined with forms state. |
| `pending` | `boolean` | `false` | Async-validation indicator; a spinner shows in the rail while `true`. |
| `touched` | `boolean` | `false` | External touched override (Signal Forms contract). |
| `dirty` | `boolean` | `false` | External dirty override (Signal Forms contract). |
| `errors` | `readonly OgeFieldError[]` | `[]` | Signal Forms validation errors (auto-bound by `[formField]`). |
| `errorText` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Explicit error message — always wins over resolved messages. |
| `errorDisplay` | `OgeInputErrorDisplay` | `'touched'` | When resolved errors become visible. |
| `debounce` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Commit delay in ms for `value`/forms updates; blur and Enter flush immediately. |

#### Methods

_OgeMention methods_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close(): void` | `void` | Closes the suggestion list. |

_Common (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus(): void` | `void` | Moves keyboard focus to the native input. |
| `blur(): void` | `void` | Blurs the native input. |
| `clear(): void` | `void` | Clears the value (commits immediately), keeps focus in the field; no-op when disabled/readonly. |
| `reset(value?: T): void` | `void` | Returns the field to pristine: sets `value` (default: empty), clears touched/dirty/parse errors, cancels pending commits. On a reactive-forms-bound editor resets the control itself. |

#### Events

_OgeMention events_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mentionSelected` | `OgeMentionSelectedEvent<T>` | A suggestion was inserted. |
| `mentionsChange` | `readonly OgeMentionToken<T>[]` | Implicit output of the `mentions` model — after an insert and after an edit that shifted or dropped a mention. |
| `searchChanged` | `OgeMentionSearchChangedEvent` | The query after a trigger changed — drive your own server-side suggestions from here. |

_Common (all editors)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueCommitted` | `OgeInputValueCommittedEvent<T>` | Every committed change with `previousValue` + originating DOM event (`undefined` for programmatic writes) — the reference `onValueChanged` shape. |
| `inputChange` | `OgeInputRawEvent` | Raw text on every keystroke, regardless of commit policy. |
| `cleared` | `void` | Value cleared via the clear button / `clear()`. |
| `enterKey` | `OgeInputKeyEvent` | Enter pressed inside the editor (pending debounce is flushed first). |
| `focused` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor received focus. |
| `blurred` | `OgeInputFocusEvent` | The editor lost focus. |
| `touch` | `void` | Signal Forms `FormValueControl` contract — emitted once per blur. |
| `valueChange` | `T` | Implicit output of the `value` model. |

#### Types

_Mention types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeMentionTrigger<T>` | `{ char: string; items: OgeMentionItemsSource<T>; displayExpr?; valueExpr?; searchExpr? }` | One trigger character and the items it suggests. |
| `OgeMentionItemsSource<T>` | `readonly T[] \| ((query: string) => readonly T[] \| PromiseLike<readonly T[]>)` | A list filtered locally by the query, or a function of the query (debounced by `searchTimeout`; stale answers are dropped) returning the filtered items. |
| `OgeMentionToken<T>` | `{ trigger: string; item: T; value: unknown; text: string; start: number; end: number }` | An inserted mention — the item, its `valueExpr` value, the inserted text and its `[start, end)` range. Tokens shift with edits before them and drop out when edited. |
| `OgeMentionSelectedEvent<T>` | `{ token: OgeMentionToken<T>; item: T; event: Event \| undefined }` | Payload of the mention-selected event. |
| `OgeMentionSearchChangedEvent` | `{ trigger: string; text: string }` | Payload of the search-changed event. |
| `OgeMentionItemTemplate` | `directive` | `<ng-template ogeMentionItemTemplate let-item>` child — a custom suggestion row; wins over `itemTemplate`. |
| `OgeMentionItemTemplateContext<T>` | `{ $implicit: T; item: T; index: number; trigger: string; query: string; active: boolean }` | Context of a custom suggestion row. |
| `Keyboard` | `APG combobox` | ArrowDown/ArrowUp move the active suggestion, PageUp/PageDown jump to the ends, Enter or Tab insert, Escape closes until the next trigger. A trigger counts only at the start or after whitespace. The single-line field is `role="combobox"`; the text area keeps its textbox role (ARIA allows no combobox role there) with `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-controls` and `aria-activedescendant`. |

### Shared input types

#### Types

_Unions & contracts_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeInputLabelMode` | `'static' \| 'floating' \| 'hidden' \| 'outside'` | `hidden` renders the label as `aria-label` only. |
| `OgeInputStylingMode` | `'outlined' \| 'filled' \| 'underlined'` | Container fill style. |
| `OgeInputSize` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | 28 / 34 / 42px heights. |
| `OgeInputSubscriptSizing` | `'fixed' \| 'dynamic' \| 'none'` | `fixed` reserves one line so errors never shift layout. |
| `OgeInputErrorDisplay` | `'touched' \| 'dirty' \| 'always'` | When resolved errors become visible. |
| `OgeInputCounterMode` | `'limit' \| 'soft'` | `soft` allows typing past `maxLength` and colors the counter danger. |
| `OgeInputShowSuccessIcon` | `false \| 'touched' \| 'always'` | Success-icon visibility policy. |
| `OgeTextBoxMode` | `'text' \| 'email' \| 'password' \| 'search' \| 'tel' \| 'url'` | Native input type of the text box. |
| `OgeNumberBoxMode` | `'text' \| 'tel'` | Native input type of the number box. |
| `OgeFieldError` | `{ kind: string; message?: string }` | Structural mirror of Signal Forms' `ValidationError`. |

_Mask_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeMaskRule` | `RegExp \| string \| ((char: string) => boolean)` | One custom mask rule: a one-character `RegExp`, a string listing the allowed characters, or a predicate. |
| `OgeMaskRules` | `Readonly<Record<string, OgeMaskRule>>` | Custom rules keyed by a single mask character. |
| `OgeMaskShowMode` | `'always' \| 'onFocus'` | When the empty mask placeholders are visible. |
| `OgeMaskCompletedEvent` | `{ value: string; rawValue: string; maskedValue: string }` | Payload of `maskCompleted`. |
| `ogeMaskComplete(mask, value, { rules?, includeLiterals? })` | `boolean` | From `@oge-ui/behavior`: `true` when `value` fills every required slot (empty counts as complete) — the check a Signal Forms `validate()` or a server runs without an editor. |

_Event payloads_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeInputValueCommittedEvent<T>` | `{ value: T; previousValue: T; event: Event \| undefined }` | `event === undefined` means a programmatic change. |
| `OgeInputRawEvent` | `{ text: string; event: Event }` | Raw keystroke payload. |
| `OgeInputKeyEvent` | `{ event: KeyboardEvent }` | Enter-key payload. |
| `OgeInputFocusEvent` | `{ event: FocusEvent }` | Focus/blur payload. |

_Slots & helpers_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeInputPrefix` | `directive — [ogeInputPrefix]` | Leading adornment inside the field. |
| `OgeInputSuffix` | `directive — [ogeInputSuffix]` | Trailing adornment; renders after the built-in rail buttons. |
| `resolveErrorMessage(sfErrors, cvaErrors, messages)` | `string \| null` | The single message a field displays. Signal Forms errors win over reactive-forms errors, and an explicit `message` wins over the kind→message map. Exported so a form-level error summary reads exactly like the inline text. |
| `formatPattern(pattern, values)` | `string` | Interpolates `{token}` placeholders in a message — the same contract the grid uses for its message patterns. |
| `OgeInputCounterState` | `{ count: number; max: number \| undefined; over: boolean }` | Counter state rendered in the subscript end slot. |
| `OgeInputRevealApi` | `{ visible; active; toggle() }` | Password-reveal API (text box only). |
| `OgeInputCopyApi` | `{ visible; copied; trigger() }` | Copy-to-clipboard API (text box only). |
| `OgeInputSpinApi` | `{ visible; canUp; canDown; press(dir, event); release() }` | Spin-button API (number box only). |
| `measureTextAreaHeight(el, minRows, maxRows?)` | `number` | Fallback auto-resize measurement for browsers without CSS `field-sizing: content`. |

### Inputs configuration

#### Methods

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provideOgeInputsConfig(config: OgeInputsConfigInput): Provider` | `Provider` | Application- or component-scoped defaults; deep-merges `messages` over the defaults. |

#### Types

_OgeInputsConfig_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spinRepeatDelayMs` | `number` | `400` | Delay before spin buttons start repeating. |
| `spinRepeatIntervalMs` | `number` | `80` | Interval between spin repeats. |
| `copiedResetMs` | `number` | `2000` | How long the copy button shows "copied". |
| `adaptiveMode` | `'auto' \| 'none'` | `'none'` | Default `adaptiveMode` of every popup editor (select box, tag box, autocomplete, tree select, date / date range / color box). `'none'` keeps existing apps' anchored drop-downs; switch the whole family with `'auto'`. |
| `adaptiveBreakpoint` | `number` | `600` | Viewport width (px) below which `'auto'` presents popups as bottom sheets / full-screen dialogs. |
| `dataPageSize` | `number` | `30` | Rows a list editor asks its `dataSource` for per page (select box, tag box, autocomplete, multi-column combo box). |
| `messages` | `OgeInputsMessages` | `—` | User-facing strings (see below). |

_OgeInputsMessages_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clearButton` | `string` | `'Clear'` | Aria label of the clear (✕) button. |
| `showPassword / hidePassword` | `string` | `'Show password' / 'Hide password'` | Reveal toggle aria labels. |
| `copyButton / copied` | `string` | `'Copy to clipboard' / 'Copied'` | Copy button aria label and transient confirmation. |
| `spinIncrement / spinDecrement` | `string` | `'Increase value' / 'Decrease value'` | Aria labels of the spin buttons. |
| `pending / valid` | `string` | `'Validating' / 'Valid'` | Screen-reader text next to the pending spinner / success icon. |
| `counter / counterNoMax` | `string` | `'{count}/{max}' / '{count}'` | Visual counter patterns. |
| `counterAria / counterAriaNoMax` | `string` | `'{count} of {max} characters used' / '{count} characters entered'` | Counter aria labels. |
| `requiredError` | `string` | `'This field is required'` | Resolved message for the `required` error kind. |
| `emailError` | `string` | `'Enter a valid email address'` | Resolved message for the `email` error kind. |
| `minError / maxError` | `string` | `'Value must be at least {min}' / '…at most {max}'` | Numeric bound errors. |
| `minLengthError / maxLengthError` | `string` | `'Enter at least {requiredLength} characters' / 'Enter no more than…'` | Length errors. |
| `patternError` | `string` | `'The value has an invalid format'` | Pattern mismatch. |
| `maskInvalidError` | `string` | `'Complete the value in the required format'` | Text box / masked text box: required mask slots are empty (also the `mask` Signal Forms error kind). `maskInvalidMessage` overrides it per editor. |
| `invalidNumberError` | `string` | `'Enter a valid number'` | Number box parse failure (reverts on blur). |
| `invalidError` | `string` | `'Invalid value'` | Fallback for unknown validation error kinds. |
| `moreTags` | `string` | `'+{count} more'` | Overflow chip of `maxDisplayedTags` (tag box, tree select chips, multi-column combo box). Rendered by `ogeMoreTagsText` / `ogeFormatMessage`, so it may be an ICU plural (`{count, plural, one {+# weiteres} other {+# weitere}}`). |
| `maxSelectedItemsMessage` | `string` | `'You can select up to {max} items'` | Status shown once `maxSelectedItems` is reached. |
| `compareError` | `string` | `'The values do not match'` | Resolved message for the forms `compare` rule. |
| `nowButton` | `string` | `'Now'` | Date box footer button of `showNowButton`. |
| `presetsLabel / presetToday … presetLastYear` | `string` | `'Quick ranges' / 'Today' … 'Last year'` | Aria label of the date range box preset list, and the labels of the built-in `ogeDateRangePresets` (`presetToday`, `presetYesterday`, `presetLast7Days`, `presetLast30Days`, `presetThisWeek`, `presetLastWeek`, `presetThisMonth`, `presetLastMonth`, `presetThisYear`, `presetLastYear`). |
| `hourColumnLabel / minuteColumnLabel / secondColumnLabel / dayPeriodColumnLabel` | `string` | `'Hours' / 'Minutes' / 'Seconds' / 'AM/PM'` | Aria labels of the time picker columns (`timeView: 'columns'`). |
| `segmentDay / segmentMonth / segmentYear / segmentHour / segmentMinute / segmentSecond / segmentDayPeriod` | `string` | `'dd' / 'mm' / 'yyyy' / 'hh' / 'mm' / 'ss' / '--'` | Empty-segment placeholders of the masked date entry (`useMaskBehavior`) — translate them with the UI (`TT.MM.JJJJ`). |

## Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

### Basic

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeAutocomplete } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeAutocomplete],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <oge-autocomplete
      label="City"
      [items]="cities"
      [(value)]="cityName"
    />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly cities = ['Ankara', 'Berlin', 'Lisbon', 'Oslo', 'Tokyo'];

  // the committed value is the TEXT itself, not an item value
  protected readonly cityName = signal('');
}
```

### Chrome

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeAutocomplete } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeAutocomplete],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <oge-autocomplete
      label="Tag"
      labelMode="floating"
      [showClearButton]="true"
      [showDropDownButton]="true"
      [openOnFieldClick]="true"
      hint="Start typing to search"
      [items]="tags"
      [(value)]="tag"
    />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly tags = ['angular', 'signals', 'zoneless'];
  protected readonly tag = signal('');
}
```

### Force

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeAutocomplete } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeAutocomplete],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <oge-autocomplete
      label="Assignee"
      [items]="users"
      displayExpr="name"
      [forceSelection]="true"
      [(value)]="assigneeName"
      (selectionChanged)="assignee = $event.item"
    />

    <!-- non-matching text reverts on blur; an exact match resolves
         to the item (canonical casing) and fires selectionChanged -->
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly users = [
    { id: 1, name: 'Elif Kaya' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Mert Demir' },
  ];

  protected readonly assigneeName = signal('');
  protected assignee: unknown = null;
}
```

### Lazy

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeAutocomplete } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeAutocomplete],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <oge-autocomplete
      label="Repository"
      [items]="loadRepos"
      [(value)]="repo"
    />

    <!-- or fully server-side: keep [items] in sync yourself -->
    <oge-autocomplete
      [items]="serverItems()"
      [loading]="serverLoading()"
      [searchTimeout]="300"
      (searchChanged)="queryServer($event.text)"
    />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly repo = signal('');

  // invoked once, on first open
  protected readonly loadRepos = (): Promise<string[]> =>
    fetch('/api/repos').then((response) => response.json());

  protected readonly serverItems = signal<string[]>([]);
  protected readonly serverLoading = signal(false);

  protected queryServer(text: string): void {
    this.serverLoading.set(true);
    fetch(`/api/repos?q=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json())
      .then((items: string[]) => this.serverItems.set(items))
      .finally(() => this.serverLoading.set(false));
  }
}
```

### Tuning

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeAutocomplete } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeAutocomplete],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <oge-autocomplete
      label="Product"
      [items]="products"
      displayExpr="name"
      searchMode="startswith"
      [minSearchLength]="2"
      [maxItemCount]="5"
      [(value)]="productName"
    />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly products = [
    { id: 1, name: 'Aurora Display' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Aurora Keyboard' },
    { id: 3, name: 'Nimbus Router' },
  ];

  protected readonly productName = signal('');
}
```

### Virtual

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeAutocomplete, OgeSelectBox } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeAutocomplete, OgeSelectBox],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <!-- 10 000 rows, ~15 in the DOM -->
    <oge-autocomplete
      label="Account"
      [items]="accounts"
      [virtualScroll]="true"
      [maxItemCount]="10000"
      [(value)]="accountName"
    />

    <oge-select-box
      label="Account"
      [items]="accounts"
      [searchEnabled]="true"
      [virtualScroll]="{ overscan: 6 }"
      [(value)]="accountId"
    />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly accounts = Array.from(
    { length: 10000 },
    (_, index) => `Account ${index + 1}`,
  );

  protected readonly accountName = signal('');
  protected readonly accountId = signal<unknown>(null);
}
```

### Basic

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeCheckBoxGroup } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeCheckBoxGroup],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <!-- One real check box per item (native semantics, its own Tab stop —
         the APG checkbox group) inside a role="group" named by the label. The
         value is the ARRAY of checked valueExpr results, in items order however
         the user clicked. Disabled items keep their state. -->
    <oge-check-box-group
      label="Notify me by"
      hint="We never share your details."
      [items]="channels"
      displayExpr="name"
      valueExpr="id"
      disabledExpr="locked"
      [(value)]="notify"
    />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly channels = [
    { id: 'mail', name: 'E-mail' },
    { id: 'sms', name: 'SMS' },
    { id: 'push', name: 'Push (always on)', locked: true },
    { id: 'call', name: 'Phone call' },
  ];
  protected readonly notify = signal<readonly unknown[]>(['mail', 'push']);
}
```

### Forms

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeCheckBoxGroup } from '@oge-ui/inputs';
import { FormField, form, minLength } from '@angular/forms/signals';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeCheckBoxGroup, FormField],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <!-- Signal Forms' required() treats [] as a value, so "at least one"
         is minLength(…, 1) with its own message. Reactive Validators.required
         treats [] as empty and works as is. -->
    <oge-check-box-group
      label="Interests"
      [items]="interests"
      [formField]="f.interests"
    />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly interests = ['Design', 'Engineering', 'Product', 'Sales'];
  protected readonly model = signal<{ interests: readonly unknown[] }>({ interests: [] });
  protected readonly f = form(this.model, (p) => {
    minLength(p.interests, 1, { message: 'Pick at least one interest' });
  });
}
```

### Formats

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeColorBox } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeColorBox],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <!-- format controls the committed string shape ('hex' default —
         the DevExtreme choice; Kendo defaults to rgba). editAlphaChannel adds the
         alpha slider + input; a translucent color then WIDENS the output
         (#rrggbbaa / rgba() / hsla()), while opaque colors stay compact. Without
         it, alpha is coerced to 1 on commit — rgba() text still parses. -->
    <oge-color-box label="Overlay" format="rgba" [editAlphaChannel]="true" [(value)]="overlay" />
    <oge-color-box label="Accent (hsl)" format="hsl" [(value)]="accent" />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly overlay = signal<string | null>('rgba(58, 160, 255, 0.5)');
  protected readonly accent = signal<string | null>('hsl(210, 100%, 61%)');
}
```

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',

  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
```

```ts
    <!-- Typed text parses ANY CSS color — #rgb/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa,
         rgb()/rgba() (comma and space/slash syntax), hsl(), the 148 named colors,
         'transparent'. Commits normalize to format; unparseable text shows the
         invalid state while typing and REVERTS on blur — a wrong color is never
         committed. acceptCustomValue=false makes the text read-only. -->
```

### Contrast

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { OgeColorGradient, contrastRatio, contrastLevels } from '@oge-ui/inputs';

@Component({
  selector: 'demo-root',
  imports: [OgeColorGradient],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <!-- showContrast renders the WCAG readout — the ratio of the current
         color against contrastBackground (translucent colors are composited over
         it first) and AA (4.5:1) / AAA (7:1) verdicts. The same math is exported:
         contrastRatio() + contrastLevels(). -->
    <oge-color-gradient
      label="Text color"
      [showContrast]="true"
      contrastBackground="#ffffff"
      [(value)]="text"
    />
  `,
})
export class Demo {
  protected readonly text = signal<string | null>('#767676');

  /** The same verdict in code — e.g. to block a save. */
  protected readonly passesAa = (fg: { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number }) =>
    contrastLevels(contrastRatio(fg, { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 1 })).aa;
}
```

```ts
    />
```

```ts
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';

  template: `
```

```ts
         dialog). Built-ins take their labels from the messages; a custom
         preset is { label, range: () => [start, end] }. -->
    <oge-date-range-box label="Report period" [presets]="presets" [(value)]="report" />

    <!-- type="time": a time-range picker — no calendar, two lists + OK -->
    <oge-date-range-box label="Opening hours" type="time" [interval]="30" [(value)]="hours" />
  `,

    ogeDateRangePresets.today(),
    ogeDateRangePresets.last7Days(),
    ogeDateRangePresets.last30Days(),
    ogeDateRangePresets.thisMonth(),
    ogeDateRangePresets.lastMonth(),
    ogeDateRangePresets.thisYear(),
    { label: 'Q1 2026', range: () => [new Date(2026, 0, 1), new Date(2026, 2, 31)] },
  ];
  protected readonly report = signal<OgeCalendarRange>([null, null]);
  protected readonly hours = signal<OgeCalendarRange>([
    new Date(2026, 7, 15, 9, 0),
    new Date(2026, 7, 15, 17, 30),
```
